coding: All 4156 exact unique cleaned texts are reread under the unchanged v5 manual, then mapped to 5414 nonempty posts; all 9532 observation states remain preserved. No trial or old labels are imported as production answers.
candidate_source: The seven labels that passed the already frozen outcome-blind pilot consistency screen. Guidance, request and offer remain descriptive unless a separate future review supplies enough positive evidence.
joint_sample_rule: Screen candidates on their own known rows, take the common known sample for retained candidates, remove only candidates failing the same support threshold in that common sample and repeat to stability. Removal reasons and population are reported; no outcome or coefficient is used.
controls: log_length + has_tag + emoji_count + course_ref + C(contentTypeStr) + C(type) + C(time_bin) + C(author) + C(date)
uncertainty: OLS with author-clustered sandwich standard errors, finite-sample correction and author-cluster t reference. BH separately within each reported expression test family/specification; it does not cover the prior research search.
main: All supported main expression parents jointly, with controls and author/date effects; conditional attributes are omitted.
separate_comparisons: One expression at a time on its own largest available known sample
One expression at a time on the main common sample
topic_adjusted: Add supported topic indicators with main expressions on their common known sample; reestimate expression-only design on the identical sample for comparison. Topics are overlapping indicators, not NMF weights.
polarity: Within S_EXPERIENCE or S_APPRAISAL positive posts and both polarity attributes yes/no, form positive-only, negative-only, mixed, neither. Retain levels passing the same support rule (each level vs other known levels), prefer positive-only as reference if supported otherwise largest supported level with lexical tie-break. Unsupported levels remain descriptive and are explicitly excluded from this conditional comparison; require at least two supported levels and recheck support on the retained sample. Use the same controls. BH within estimated contrasts. Parent identification disagreement remains disclosed.
other_attributes: Event assertion, plan/goal, greeting/thanks described conditionally; no extra hypothesis tests are added in this run.
rank: Diagnose controls alone, discard constant/linearly redundant control columns by pivoted QR only if required, retain all estimable focal columns, then verify full rank. If a focal column is absorbed by controls or redundant, report non-estimability rather than silently dropping it. Record any omitted controls.
collinearity: Full-design rank and VIF on actual complete samples, with independent residual-regression VIF check. Pairwise phi and co-positive counts are descriptive, not tests of semantic validity. VIF>=5 triggers review, not automatic semantic merging.
robustness_for_main: Exclude posts above the main-sample 99th percentile of likes
Retain authors with at least 10 main-sample posts
Author-equal WLS, weights inverse main-sample author post count
historical_comparison: Compare coverage on the same 5414 posts using historical sources, retain v2/v3 definitions as historical; do not reinterpret old coefficients as v5. Original NMF continuous-weight model remains unchanged and separate.
validation: Structural/evidence/source checks for every batch; compare fresh production coding with both frozen pilot codings on the original separate random and targeted samples. These are same-base AI agreement checks, not independent human accuracy or a never-seen corpus.
privacy: Raw text, exact evidence, anonymous row annotations and post mappings stay under the ignored private directory. Public artifacts contain only methods, aggregate findings and deidentified figures.
limits: No standardized exposure or observation window; likes are counts, not a like rate
Multiple retrospective explorations remain outside within-family BH
Observational conditional associations do not establish causal effects
